Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649971. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649971. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno to get chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require structures. Filter for exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
